@xterm/xterm 6.0.0
@xterm/addon-fit 0.11.0

Vendoring policy:
- Runtime/build does not use npm, CDN, or a package manager for these assets.
- The reviewed JavaScript/CSS/license files are committed directly under web/vendor/ and embedded into the Go binary.
- Future upgrades must be performed manually: obtain the exact upstream source/release, review it, replace the committed files, update this provenance record, and commit the reviewed result.

Upstream projects:
- https://github.com/xtermjs/xterm.js/tree/6.0.0
- https://github.com/xtermjs/xterm.js/tree/6.0.0/addons/addon-fit

Vendored files:
- xterm.js
- xterm.css
- addon-fit.js
- LICENSE-xterm.txt
- LICENSE-addon-fit.txt
